title: A Sigil for the Choir
author: Cyrus Okonkwo
blurb: Sebastian Eriksen, a mercenary sworn to a god that went silent, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. But when the crown announces a hunt for anyone with the gift, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must steal back a soul sold to the court beneath the mountain, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
